description: str_matches_glob calls sieve_glob_to_regex_capturing(pattern) which returns (regex_pat, star_count). The star_count is discarded. The function then calls str_matches_regex_pat which uses the regex WITHOUT capturing groups. However sieve_glob_to_regex_capturing always inserts capturing groups (.*) for each star. These capture groups are compiled into the regex but never used when called via str_matches_glob. A non-capturing version sieve_glob_to_regex_simple that uses (.*) without capture wrappers would be slightly more efficient for the non-capture path (header :matches without variables enabled, and header :is/:contains/:regex).
title: sieve-native: str_matches_glob calls sieve_glob_to_regex_capturing but discards captures; redundant work
